newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DUTCHMAN APPOINTED TOP EU BUREAUCRAT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCHMAN APPOINTED TOP EU BUREAUCRAT.

text.p: The European Commission appointed Dutchman Carlo Trojan to its top administrative post on Wednesday, replacing Britain's David Williamson who is retiring as secretary general.
Secretary general of the Commission, the European Union's executive, is an extremely powerful position, leading the entire administration and involved in all issues.
Only two men have previously held the post over the 40-year history of the Commission. The first, Frenchman Emile Noel, held it from 1958 until his retirement in 1987.
